'''Mexeluine''' was a thriving [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] lying along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Originally settled during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] efforts to harvest the economic potential of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mexeluine grew wealthy as a result of [[Figg & Associates]]' commercial development of the region. Mexeluine successfully positioned itself as a cheaper alternative to neighboring [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]], the region's commercial [[Capital/Legends|capital]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Mexeluine, the namesake of the [[Mexeluine system/Legends|Mexeluine system]], was located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], within the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Mexeluine lay along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], just [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] of the megaworld [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] and positioned between the sprawling [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==History==
A [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] prior to the events of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mexeluine sat in a largely uncharted region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] beyond the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was then considered a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. In an era before the Corellian Trade Spine extended past the edge of the Mid Rim, only [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and the most daring [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] braved this imperfectly surveyed [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] frontier. The presence of the vast Twin Nebulae proved the chief impediment to [[Astrogation/Legends|navigation]] efforts through the region, stymieing countless [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorers who dreamed of opening the Trade Spine to greater commercial opportunities.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Fortunes began to change following the conclusion of a brief, one-sided [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the region's native [[Mugaari]], which left the Republic free to colonize a number of planets along the Trade Spine in the newly established [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], much of which was later reorganized as the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), states that the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] was established in the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] life. The text states that Figg [[Death/Legends|died]] nearly four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to its setting, thus providing an approximate date of [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] for the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] establishment.</ref> Staging from these newly settled worlds, including Mexeluine and neighboring Gerrenthum, Republic traders continued to search for a hyperspace shortcut through the Twin Nebulae, but it would be [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] succeeded where his predecessors had failed.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Figg's new hyperspace routes turned the Twin Nebulae region into an economic powerhouse. Gerrenthum, in turn, reaped the benefits of its fortuitous position at the junction of three lucrative trade routes, developing into the region's commercial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] as the headquarters of various Figg corporations. Left to compete with its bustling neighbor, Mexeluine grew into a wealthy<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> and thriving trade world<ref name="Atlas" /> from the money that [[Figg & Associates]] infused into the sector, by successfully offering cheaper [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] rates than Gerrenthum.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Inhabitants==
Mexeluine was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Gir Endac]], a member of [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the Galactic Civil War. Endac helped fight corruption within the [[Cloud City Miner's Guild]].<ref name="Insider 148" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mexeluine was created for "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards.com|online]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
